notes.title: Version 0.84 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]

[list]
[*]Added limited-time [b]Summer[/b] arena.
[*]Added the option to set BinxCoin rewards for cars that are hit by Special Event projectiles. This option is found in the Settings > Binx menu.
[*]When a player earns BinxCoins on a round win, the amount won is now displayed on the Winner screen.
[*]Fixed an issue causing the game to get stuck on Loading screen.
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.83 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*]Added [b]Mars[/b] arena.
[*]Added visual deformation physics for Derby cars.
[*]Improved damage accuracy.
[*]Added the ability to connect your Binx account to Crash'em Derby.
[*]Added the option to set up BinxCoin rewards for round winners. Once your Binx account has been connected to the game, this option can be found in the Settings > Binx menu. 
[*]Added an option to turn on car health bars. They can be enabled via the Settings > Game menu.
[*]New music from [url=https://themesshall.co.uk/sessions/]TMH[/url] added to in-game music player.
[*]Removed Spring Holiday limited-time arena.
[*]Miscellaneous bug fixes.
[*]And lastly, the [b]Crash'em Derby Circuit has re-launched![/b] Each month, the top 3 players and streamers will be awarded with a selection of rare BinxCards. Be sure to connect your Binx account to Crash'em Derby for your and your players' scores to be tracked on the leaderboard.
[/list]
